name: potato-marines
author: Crystal Mods
description: Aggressive FPS mod for poor PCs. (1) Data pak forcing the engine's CPU systems below the lowest in-game tier: swarm spawn 0.7->0.2, gibs 23/43->6/12, ragdolls 5/15->0/2 (instant freeze), corpse cap 40->8, gore 65->12. (2) Engine config (game.cfg) disabling SSAO/SSR/RTAO/DOF/water-sim/covering/capsule+screen-space shadows, flooring volumetric-fog/lightshaft/shadow/effects quality, and capping engine workers to 8 (CPU job tuning). Private-lobby mod; local-install only, NOT published to Steam Workshop.
